retirement_guidance: Do not add new strategy to docs/archive.
Replace old release guards with current capability tests before moving their required audit files.
Keep DOC_INDEX.md as the human navigation map and this JSON as the Admin Docs report source.
Use short build-sync notes in retained audit files rather than copying the full roadmap into each file.
current_app_position: Connected lead/quote to repeat-maintenance workflow foundation.
Live detailer/customer interaction now supports notes, photos, videos, stages, admin review, staff-only privacy, and customer-safe publication.
Routine content uses friendly editors; raw JSON remains emergency-only.
Desktop/mobile visual, gallery, incident, payment, accounting, SEO, and media diagnostics are present.
Highest next value is notifications, unread state, proof checklist integration, media retention/compression, and completed-job handoff.
remaining_doc_risk: Historical audit files are still large because many release guards depend on them. Build 209 reduces active planning to two files and archives twenty redundant files without deleting context.
